description: Final refit (D-17): published v4 architecture trained on every observed year, fixed 150 epochs. Out-of-sample evidence: docs/ml/performance-v10.md (T1f, T2f) and V14.
selection_rule: configuration and training length fixed on development folds D2b and D3b (v10); no year held out

thresholds.method: Same rule as v4: percentile rank within the frozen reference distribution of all cell x subperiod estimates of the training years. Low < 40, medium 40 to < 70, high >= 70.
